sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.4

Hotfix: signed-in members were returned to the Sign In page about five minutes after logging in. This affects sites running 4.5.3 and is resolved by updating.

  • The storefront no longer treats a lapsed sign-in cookie as proof that the member is signed out. It re-checks with the server before changing anything.
  • On page load, a returning member is reconciled against the profile endpoint, so a valid session survives the cookie lapse. First-time anonymous visitors still make no extra requests.
  • On checkout and account pages, a change in sign-in state is re-verified before any redirect, which removes the bounce partway through checkout.
  • A genuinely expired or signed-out session still lands on Sign In, with no repeat sign-in loop.

No customer data, cart contents or orders were affected. Sessions stayed valid throughout; only the interface treated members as signed out.
